notes: Kais Saied won second round with 72.71% (2,777,931 votes) vs Nabil Karoui 27.29% (1,042,894 votes). Published in JORT n° 85 (2019).

organization: Instance Supérieure Indépendante pour les Élections (ISIE)

notes: Kais Saied re-elected with 90.69% (2,438,954 votes) on 28.8% turnout. Published in JORT (2024).

organization: Presidency of the Republic of Tunisia
title: Décret présidentiel n° 2021-117 du 22 septembre 2021, relatif aux mesures exceptionnelles
notes: Established plenary presidential decree authority, suspended chapter 1 & 2 of 2014 Constitution conflicting with decree powers, abolished provisional constitutional review instance.

title: Constitution de la République Tunisienne adoptée par référendum le 25 juillet 2022
notes: Promulgated in JORT n° 89. Adopted with 94.6% yes votes on 30.5% turnout. Replaces 2014 Constitution.

title: Décret-loi n° 2022-54 du 13 septembre 2022, relatif à la lutte contre les infractions se rapportant aux systèmes d'information et de communication
notes: Article 24 establishes 5-year prison terms (10 years if public official targeted) for spreading false news.

title: Décret présidentiel n° 2022-516 du 1er juin 2022, portant révocation de magistrats
notes: Executive revocation of 57 magistrates. Administrative Court suspended dismissals for 49 judges on Aug 9, 2022.

title: Credit Opinion: Government of Tunisia - Caa2 Stable
notes: Affirmed Caa2 rating with Stable outlook.

title: Fitch Upgrades Tunisia to 'CCC+'
notes: Upgraded sovereign credit rating from CCC- to CCC+.

title: Arab Barometer Wave V: Tunisia Country Report
notes: n=2,400 face-to-face probability sample. ±2.5% margin of error. Trust in president: 18%; trust in gov: 18%; trust in parliament: 14%; trust in police: 65%; youth migration intent: 42%.

title: Arab Barometer Wave VII: Tunisia Country Report - Public Opinion After July 25
notes: n=2,424 face-to-face probability sample. ±2.5% margin of error. Trust in Kais Saied: 62%; trust in gov: 39%; trust in parliament: 12%; trust in police: 67%; youth migration intent: 46%.

title: Arab Barometer Wave VIII: Tunisia Country Report - Views on Governance and Economy
notes: n=2,406 face-to-face probability sample. ±2.5% margin of error. Trust in Kais Saied: 43%; trust in gov: 25%; trust in parliament: 18%; trust in police: 61%; youth migration intent (18-29): 53%; economic condition good: 6%.

title: Memorandum of Understanding on a Strategic and Global Partnership between the European Union and Tunisia
notes: Signed in Tunis. €105M for border management and anti-smuggling; €150M in direct budgetary assistance disbursed March 2024.

title: IMF Staff Reaches Staff-Level Agreement on an Extended Fund Facility with Tunisia
notes: 48-month EFF arrangement for SDR 1.472 billion (~$1.9 billion). Execution stalled without Executive Board submission.

title: Tunisia-Italy Power Interconnector - ELMED Project (P179247)
notes: 600 MW, 200 km HVDC undersea cable co-financed by €307.6M EU Connecting Europe Facility grant and $268.4M World Bank financing.

title: Audit Environnemental et Social de la Gestion du Phosphogypse à Gabès (Projet PGSE P118870)
notes: Establishes historical baseline of ~14,000 tonnes/day dry-solid phosphogypsum marine discharge into Gulf of Gabès.

organization: Prime Ministry of the Republic of Tunisia
title: Communiqué du Conseil des Ministres du 29 juin 2017 relatif au transfert des unités industrielles du GCT à Gabès
